component.name: Leggio
component.summary: Read sheet music PDFs from a screen on your music stand

description.p: Leggio shows your sheet music PDFs on screen, so you can put a laptop or tablet on a music stand and play from it instead of from paper.
It keeps a library of your scores, which you can search by title, composer or tag and group into setlists. Scores open fullscreen with nothing else in the way, and pages turn instantly.

ul.li: Cuts off the white margins, so the notes fill the screen
Half-page turns, so you can see what is coming next
Turn pages by tap, swipe, keyboard or Bluetooth page-turner pedal
Two pages side by side on a wide screen, one page on a tall one
Draw on a score with a pen, highlighter, eraser and musical symbols
Night mode turns pages white-on-black for dark stages
A setlist reads as one long document, several scores in a row
Remembers where you stopped in each score
Keeps the screen from going to sleep while you play

description.p: Your PDF files are never changed. Everything Leggio saves is kept in its own library.

screenshot.caption: The score library, with tags and setlists
A score in night mode, two pages side by side

description.p: A new app ID, ready for Flathub.

ul.li: The app ID is now io.github.mrgilfy.leggio. Flatpak users: before starting this version for the first time, move your library across with "mv ~/.var/app/io.github.MrGilfy.Leggio ~/.var/app/io.github.mrgilfy.leggio", then remove the old app with "flatpak uninstall io.github.MrGilfy.Leggio"
Installs from the AUR or from source keep their library without any steps

description.p: Jump links, bookmarks with a page overview, and PDF export with your annotations.

ul.li: Jump links: tap a D.S., D.C., To Coda or repeat sign to jump to its target, then Back to return; J and B do the same from the keyboard
Bookmarks and a page overview with thumbnails, for finding your way around long scores
Export a score or a whole setlist as a PDF with your annotations drawn in; the original PDF stays untouched
Black is now the default pen colour
Clear now clears every page on screen, including the right-hand page of a spread

description.p: Night mode, a Flatpak bundle, and a screen that stays awake on more desktops.

ul.li: Night mode for dark stages turns pages white-on-black and is remembered for each score
The viewer's buttons use Leggio's own icons, so they show up with any icon theme
The screen stays awake on more desktops, including Sway and other wlroots compositors and X11, and Leggio logs a warning when it cannot keep it awake
Leggio is available as a Flatpak bundle on the releases page
Library scan messages no longer cover the score
A PDF opened directly can be opened again after a library scan
Picking a network folder without a local path no longer crashes Leggio
Library with search, sorting, tags and setlists
Fullscreen viewer with tap, swipe, keyboard and pedal page turns
Automatic margin cropping with manual adjustment
Half-page turns and automatic two-page spread
Annotation with pen, highlighter, eraser and musical symbols
